info.title: Ryax API
info.description:
The HTTP API of a Ryax installation: the API the Ryax web interface and the
`ryaxctl` command line use. It merges the four services that make up the public
surface, each under its own path prefix:

- `/api/authorization` -- users, projects and access tokens
- `/api/repository` -- git sources and the actions built from them
- `/api/studio` -- workflow authoring
- `/api/runner` -- deployments, runs and sites

Authenticate with the token of a Ryax user in an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

RunnerActionIOModel.title: ActionIOModel
RunnerActionIOModel.description:
Former ``ModuleIOSchema``: one input or output of an action.

``help``, ``enum_values`` and ``headers`` carried a marshmallow ``dump_default``,
so they were emitted even when the producer left them out. They keep a default
here, and every producer sets them explicitly (see ``PortalView.get_portal`` and
``_convert_io`` in the workflow run service), which is what keeps them in the
payload under ``exclude_unset``.
